{{Quote|We infiltrated Shu Mai's compound, but she was not there. Analysis indicates she left the system just before I arrived on Felucia.|[[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Reversal of Fortune">''[[Reversal of Fortune]]''</ref>}}
The '''Felucia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].
